dedupe_keys.name: california wildfire evacuation order database draft research repository evacuation orders by census tract for sonoma fresno and madera county fires

description: This research repository assembles a database of wildfire evacuation orders in California, started as a summer project. The archived copy read on 2026-09-28 through Software Heritage, last changed in December 2021 when figures were prepared for a poster, has a README pointing to a draft database kept in a shared spreadsheet and a plan to start with the large 2020 fires and work backwards. The data folder holds cleaned evacuation order tables for fires in Sonoma County and in Fresno and Madera Counties, a mapping of Sonoma evacuation orders to census tracts with counts by tract, census tract data, evacuation zone and fire folders, and a list of fires, alongside R scripts, figures and papers. Coverage is the California counties processed, not the whole state. Access is free; no licence is stated, and the table columns were not inspected. Caveats: the project describes itself as a draft, the authoritative version may live in the spreadsheet, not the repository, and the authors were not identified in the part read. It supports emergency response studies, such as relating evacuation orders by census tract to population, income or road access during a wildfire. Related record: the Baltimore evacuation shelter layer.
